  | ⟨_, _⟩, ⟨_, _⟩, ⟨αβ, βα⟩ => by
    apply congr_arg sSup
    ext
    constructor <;> simp <;> intro a h
    · obtain ⟨b, h'⟩ := αβ a
      exists b
      rw [← h, rank_congr h']
    · obtain ⟨b, h'⟩ := βα a
      exists b

    exact h (Mem.mk A a)
